name: Knips
description: Connect Knips with Claude, to project updates, build automated welcome flows for people who register interest, create segments of interested contacts and buyers from live data, and report on how every send performed. Everything Claude creates lands as a draft in Knips — you review, then you send.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Knips to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Knips to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.knips.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Knips MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Knips lists 26 MCP tools, including add_flow_step, create_flow, create_segment, draft_campaign, get_campaign, get_campaign_statistics, get_contact, get_flow, get_flow_blueprints, get_flows, get_links, and get_segment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Knips?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Knips in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Knips requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Knips is developed by Knips. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
